subtasks: Insert and tighten each screw into the nut of the same color.
Fasten the pink nut onto the matching upright pink screw and tighten it.
Fasten the yellow nut onto the matching upright yellow screw and tighten it.
Retract the left arm. With the right gripper, pick up the pink nut now resting just left of the upright pink screw. Place it on that screw and tighten it.

With the left gripper, regrip and tighten the red nut farther down its matching upright red screw. Repeat clockwise turns, opening to reset between turns. Retract the open right gripper clear of the pink assembly.

Tighten the seated red nut with the left hand and the seated yellow nut with the right hand on their matching upright screws. Turn each nut clockwise while gripping, then open to reset and repeat; leave the pink pair undisturbed.
Use the right gripper to grasp the yellow nut already threaded onto the upright yellow screw. Tighten it clockwise with repeated grip, turn, release and reset motions. Leave the other pairs in place.
Leave all three matched assemblies in place. Release the yellow nut, withdraw upward, then return both open grippers to their own episode-start poses.
